theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_id_tpd_hasDensity_of_ball_mass_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (a : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < a * unitBallVolume n → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall x t)) → (∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, a * unitBallVolume n < c → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μ (closedBall x t) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n) → HasDensity n μ x a
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
